title: API Testing
description: Roles and Responsibilities Lead end-to-end quality engineering for REST APIs, from requirements analysis to production validation for 5-9 years' scale projects. Design, implement, and maintain robust API test strategies covering functional, integration, contract, regression, and negative testing. Drive API test automation frameworks and suites, ensuring high coverage, reliability, and maintainability across services and microservices. Collaborate with architects and developers to review API specifications (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI), ensuring testability, consistency, and adherence to standards. Define and enforce best practices for API testing, automation, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines. Analyze complex defects and production issues, perform root cause analysis, and work with cross-functional teams to implement long-term fixes. Mentor and guide junior QA/automation engineers on API testing techniques, tools, and automation patterns. Additional Responsibilities Good to Have Skills: API design review, Contract testing, Performance testing, CI/CD integration, Agile methodologies Technical Requirements Extensive experience in API test automation, including building and maintaining automation suites for REST APIs. Demonstrated ability to define test strategies, test plans, and quality processes for complex, distributed systems. Experience integrating automated API tests into CI/CD pipelines and working in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong background in overall Testing practices, including test design techniques, risk-based testing, and regression optimization. Proven track record of leading small to medium QA/automation teams, providing technical guidance and code reviews for test assets. Ability to analyze logs, traces, and API responses to quickly diagnose issues and support root cause analysis. You'll collaborate closely with architects, developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to build robust test strategies that keep pace with modern, cloud-native delivery. This is an opportunity to influence technical direction, mentor engineers, and introduce smarter ways of working-using automation, metrics, and continuous improvement. If you enjoy solving intricate integration challenges, designing scalable API test frameworks, and leading teams toward engineering excellence, this role gives you the platform to make a visible impact while growing as a technology leader. title: Staff Software Engineer- Test
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. About the role We're hiring an SDET-2 (Software Development Engineer in Test) in Bengaluru to own quality for the services our customers depend on. You'll decide what to test and how, build and maintain automation, test by hand where it finds problems fastest, and help the team ship often without breaking customers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Quality is a first-class priority for us, not a phase at the end. You'll work closely with developers, Product, Customer Support and your Engineering Manager. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own quality for a service or product area end to end — test strategy, automation, release sign-off, and follow-up on escaped bugs. Test strategy. Decide what to automate, what to test by hand, and what risk is acceptable for each release. Automation that lasts. Build and extend API, UI and integration test suites that are fast, reliable and run in CI on every change. Shift left. Review designs and requirements early, and work with developers so testability is built in, not bolted on. Learn from escapes. When a bug reaches customers, find out why and close the gap so it doesn't happen again. Raise the bar. Review test code, mentor SDET-1s, and help interview candidates. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 2–5 years in software testing or development. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've built automation that runs in CI. Test suites you designed or substantially extended, that run on every change and that the team trusts. You own quality, not just test cases. You've decided what to test for a feature or release, and stood behind the call. You are comfortable testing by hand. You use manual and exploratory testing deliberately, where it finds problems faster than scripts. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a feature or release, you plan the testing, unblock yourself, and raise risks early. Test plan Breakdown: You can take product requirements and create deep test plan including all corner cases to ensure Quality We care how you test more than which tool you did it in. Technical background You've tested production systems with a modern stack, such as: Languages: strong in at least one language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript — you write test code with the same care as product code. Test automation: frameworks such as Pytest, JUnit/TestNG, Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, including structuring a suite so it stays maintainable. APIs and services: contract and integration testing of REST APIs, including error paths, auth and data validation. CI and cloud: running tests in CI pipelines, and testing services deployed on AWS — reading logs and metrics to diagnose failures. Databases: SQL to set up and verify data, and an understanding of how data issues show up as bugs. Non-functional testing: exposure to performance or load testing with tools such as JMeter, k6 or Locust. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. Escaped bugs went down, release time went down, or flaky tests went away — and you can say what you did to get there. A suite you made better. You took slow or flaky automation and made it fast and trusted, not just bigger. Framework mindset: You spot repeated test code and turn it into reusable helpers, fixtures or tooling others build on. Root-cause thinking. You trace a failure to its cause in code, data or config, not just report the symptom. Product sense. You've pushed back on a release, or on a requirement that would confuse users, and been right. Lifting others. Test reviews, docs or mentoring that made developers and newer SDETs better at quality. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You test the way customers actually work, and you treat every escaped bug and support ticket as a lesson. Impact over activity. You measure success by bugs that never reached customers and releases that went out smoothly, not test-case counts. Honesty. You report quality as it is, say clearly what wasn't tested, and raise release risks even when it's unwelcome. Independence. You don't wait to be told what to test. You find the risk worth covering and get it done with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a tool you built, a technique you went deep on, things you taught others. Depth. At least one system you've tested well enough to explain its internals, its failure modes and how you'd test them. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend (Java)
description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: Meet our team The Payments Risk Engineering team is responsible for fraud detection and risk management at PayPal. We design, build, and support the services that are called on every money movement transaction between PayPal and its users and partners. Our solutions scale across millions of interactions, integrate with other APIs in real time, and deliver high availability and configurability to the business. We stay current with advances in technology and science and tie them back to business needs. What You Need To Know About The Role- We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to strengthen the risk prevention and mitigation systems that protect PayPal and its customers from fraud. Our team owns fraud detection, and risk management services across PayPal globally. These services are called on every interaction between users, partners, and PayPal. We also apply advances in AI, machine learning, and data science to real business problems. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles. Advises immediate management on project-level issues Guides junior engineers Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions Minimum Qualifications: 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications: Your way to impact Protect customers and PayPal by building real-time risk systems that scale across millions of transactions. Keep payments seamless for good users while stopping fraud, with services that are highly available, reliable, and configurable. Shape the technical direction of the team by challenging the status quo, bringing fresh ideas, and championing clean, scalable engineering practices. Reduce technical debt and raise the quality bar for software and the team. Your day to day Design, develop, and test features and services for our risk applications. Work with product managers in an agile setting to deliver high-quality solutions on time. Partner with developers, product, design, and analytics teams to explore new ideas and opportunities. Work with operations teams to keep services highly available and reliable. Take part in code reviews to maintain code quality. Contribute to our automated test suite to enable fast, reliable continuous integration. Communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders. Be proactive: anticipate issues and handle them before they escalate. What Do You Need To Bring- Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline with 4-6 years of experience. Strong applied experience: you’ve built, broken, and rebuilt software, and you know how to ship real-world products. Proficiency in back-end development with Java EE technologies (Java, application servers, servlet containers, JMS, JPA). Strong object-oriented programming skills and the ability to turn requirements into scalable designs. Experience designing and building REST APIs and web services or microservices in a commercial setting. Experience with design patterns, MVC, and frameworks such as Spring. Experience with service-oriented architectures and scalable, distributed Java services. Skill in designing for reliability, availability, scalability, and performance. Familiarity with engineering tools and practices such as Java build tools, unit testing, test automation, and CI. Strong communication skills. A mindset of ownership, curiosity, and drive to get results. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don't hesitate to apply. Subsidiary: PayPal Travel Percent: 0 PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. Our Benefits: At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. Who We Are: Click Here to learn more about our culture and community. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. Belonging at PayPal: Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

title: Software Engineer
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Job Description Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter. About the role We're hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix. Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones. Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself. Design. Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers. Quality. Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them. Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next. Code reviews. Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've shipped code that runs in production. Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes. You are strong at problem solving. You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments. We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in. Technical background You've built production software with a modern stack, such as: Cloud: hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it. Languages: strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript. Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents. Databases: solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it. Fundamentals: data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability. One problem you went deep on. A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why. Ownership beyond the ticket. You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked. Framework mindset: You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable. Learning speed. You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it. Curiosity about the user. You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them. Impact over activity. You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written. Honesty. You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work. Independence. You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to. Depth. At least one thing you've built or debugged that you can explain down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

Tendering and Technical Evaluation Prepare technical tender packages, scopes, specifications and supporting drawings; check consistency with BOQs and related procurement documents. Prepare tender clarifications and technical responses; assess bidders’ technical submissions, exclusions, deviations, alternatives and compliance with project requirements. Prepare technical comparison summaries and recommendations for the Design Manager; coordinate agreed technical requirements with procurement and the commercial team. 3. Approvals and Release for Construction Assist the Design Manager and relevant consultants in preparing, checking and coordinating authority submissions, permits, NOCs and technical approval packages for the assigned scope. Track submission deadlines, approval dependencies and review comments; prepare coordinated responses and revised documentation and follow up to closure. Check that applicable design reviews and approvals are completed before documents are released for construction; coordinate controlled IFC and approved shop drawing issue with document control. Identify missing approvals and unresolved technical matters affecting procurement or site activities and promptly escalate them to the Design Manager. 4. Construction Phase Technical Support Provide ongoing technical support to construction teams, subcontractors and suppliers for the assigned disciplines from mobilisation through completion. Prepare and review RFIs, technical queries, material and equipment submittals, shop drawings, method statements and proposed technical solutions against approved documents and specifications. Prepare draft technical responses and instructions for the appropriate review and approval; attend coordination meetings and site visits to verify dimensions, levels, interfaces and actual site conditions. Coordinate the resolution of technical nonconformities and construction discrepancies with the Design Manager, consultants, site and quality teams, and verify incorporation of agreed corrective actions. Follow up technical deliverables and clarify approved requirements so that construction teams receive complete, coordinated and current information. 5. The trainer will bridge low-level hardware-software concepts with production-grade embedded coding practices through hands-on labs, target-board exercises, and real-world debugging scenarios . Key Responsibilities Corporate Training Delivery: Lead interactive classroom and/or live virtual bootcamps covering bare-metal Embedded C, resource-constrained Embedded C++, and RTOS fundamentals. Hands-on Hardware & Simulator Labs: Conduct practical labs on ARM Cortex-M / STM32 / ESP32 development boards (or QEMU/Renode simulators), guiding engineers through peripheral configuration, register-level programming, and real-time debugging. Curriculum & Lab Customization: Tailor slide decks, coding assignments, and mini-projects to align with client domain requirements (Automotive, IoT, Industrial Automation, or Consumer Electronics). Code Reviews & Assessments: Evaluate participant code for memory safety, determinism, and MISRA compliance; conduct pre- and post-training assessments and provide actionable skill-gap reports to L&D stakeholders. Required Technical Skills Embedded C & Low-Level Architecture: Pointers, function pointers, bitwise manipulation, volatile, const, memory-mapped I/O, and linker scripts/memory layout (stack, heap, .bss, .data, flash). Interrupt Service Routines (ISRs), NVIC, DMA, timers, and peripheral communication protocols ( UART, SPI, I2C, CAN ). Embedded C++ (Modern C++14/17/20 for Firmware): Deterministic OOP, RAII, constexpr, templates, type traits, and zero-overhead abstractions. Avoiding dynamic memory fragmentation (custom allocators, static allocation patterns, std::array, std::span, std::variant). RTOS & Concurrency: FreeRTOS or Zephyr RTOS concepts: task scheduling, mutexes, semaphores, message queues, deadlocks, and priority inversion. Toolchains & Debugging: Cross-compilation toolchains (arm-none-eabi-gcc), CMake/Makefiles, OpenOCD, GDB, JTAG/SWD debuggers, and static analysis tools. Good-to-Have Skills (Include based on client domain) Familiarity with MISRA C / MISRA C++ and AUTOSAR C++14 coding guidelines. Embedded Linux, device drivers, or Yocto build system experience. Unit testing and mocking for embedded targets (CppUTest, Google Test, Unity/CMock). Experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and CAN bus analyzers (CANoe/CANalyzer). Qualifications & Soft Skills Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics & Communication (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EEE), Computer Science, or Instrumentation. Minimum 5 years of hands-on embedded software/firmware development experience, with prior experience delivering corporate technical trainings. Strong ability to translate datasheet specifications and hardware constraints into clear, practical coding exercises. High professionalism, punctuality, and adaptability to corporate L&D schedules. title: Intern
description: Position Name – Training Operations & Documentation Intern – Crompton Samrudhi 1. Brief about the position: The Training Operations & Documentation Intern will support the delivery of one-day Crompton Samrudhi technician upskilling programmes across South India. The role focuses on participant registration, attendance, assessment coordination, digital data entry, evidence capture, documentation and batch closure. Interns will work alongside external/freelance trainers so trainers can focus primarily on technical training delivery, while operational and documentation requirements are completed as per the project SOP. 2. About the Crompton Samrudhi Project: The project delivers structured technical and product upskilling for existing field technicians across the South Region. Each batch is planned as a one-day programme with an average batch size of 30 participants. The current planning target is to train 4,000 participants by 31 December 2026, subject to the approved rollout calendar. The internship is intended to support batch operations and reporting through project closure. Post this tenure based on the project requirements the tenure can be considered to extent on the same project or any other relevant project, if applicable. · Job type: Fixed-term internship for the project period; final terms to be confirmed by HR. · Total vacancies: 4 nos. · Immediate joiners preferred, subject to availability and project mobilisation timelines. 3. Job Description: · Pre-Training Coordination: Coordinate with the project team and trainer to check the batch schedule, venue readiness, participant list, training materials, branding, practical tools and stationery. · Participant Registration & Records: Support registration and check completeness of required participant details and documents as per the approved process; flag missing or inconsistent records for follow-up. · Digital Registration Support: Assist participants with Skill India Digital Hub and Crompton Saathi/Sathi App registration where applicable; escalate portal, mobile or OTP issues. · Attendance & Batch Administration: Manage the registration desk, attendance sheets, participant list, batch IDs and records for distribution of approved materials such as T-shirts, badges or toolkits. · Assessment Coordination: Support pre/post-test and external assessment logistics; compile candidate-wise data and share the required batch-wise Excel sheets within the timeline set by the project manager. · Documentation & Digital Filing: Update approved Excel/Google Sheets and Zoho trackers where applicable; maintain batch-wise Google Drive folders and upload attendance, registration, assessment, scheme-linkage and stipend-related records. · Photo, Video & Evidence Capture: Capture clear geo-tagged photographs and videos of training activities, practical demonstrations and group photographs; upload evidence to the approved project folder on the same day where connectivity allows. · Trainee Case Studies: Record at least three trainee case-study/testimonial videos per batch, with participant consent, covering prior work, skills learned, expected benefits and overall feedback. · Government Scheme Linkage: Coordinate with the designated scheme-linkage agency, where assigned, and update enrolment/referral status without promising eligibility or benefits. · Material & Benefit Records: Maintain distribution/receipt records for approved materials and flag discrepancies to the project coordinator. · Daily Reporting & Batch Closure: Share updates on attendance, registrations, assessments, evidence uploads, scheme linkage and open issues; use the batch closure checklist to identify missing documentation. · Data Confidentiality & Safety: Handle personal documents only through approved systems and channels, follow photo/video consent requirements and comply with data confidentiality and venue safety instructions. 4. Reporting and Team: Reporting to: Project Coordinator / Project Manager. The intern will coordinate day-to-day with assigned external/freelance trainers, venue contacts, mobilisation teams, assessment teams and the designated scheme-linkage agency, as required. The intern supports the process and does not replace the trainer’s technical delivery responsibilities or the project manager’s approval responsibilities. 5. Work Location, Language Spoken: Work location: South India, based on assigned state/cluster and the approved training calendar. Deployment may involve travel to training venues and nearby locations. · Language: Fluency in the local language of the assigned state/cluster is essential; working knowledge of English or Hindi is desirable. · Candidates must be comfortable communicating with adult technicians, freelance trainers, venue contacts and project stakeholders. · Travel: Willingness to undertake local and, where required, inter-city travel as per the project plan. 6. Skill Set: · Communication: Clear, polite communication in the local language and basic working English or Hindi. · Computer Skills: Basic-to-good working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets, Google Forms, email and file/folder management. · Digital Documentation: Ability to scan documents, organise files, follow naming conventions and maintain accurate trackers. · Field Coordination: Ability to manage participant flow, attendance, materials and training-day logistics. · Photo/Video Skills: Comfortable using a smartphone to capture clear photos/videos and geo-tagged evidence; basic video handling is an advantage. · Personal Attributes: Organised, reliable, detail-oriented, proactive and able to work to same-day deadlines. · Data Handling: Understands the importance of confidentiality when working with participant identity and bank-related documents. 7. Grade & Salary: Stipend / monthly compensation: To be finalised by HR (tentatively 18 to 22 thousand monthly) Travel reimbursement, mobile/data allowance, working days, weekly off and any overnight travel arrangements should be confirmed in the internship offer. 8. Qualification & Experience: Final-year student, recent graduate or diploma holder in any discipline. Candidates from Business Administration, Commerce, Social Work, Rural Development, IT/Computer Applications, Data Management or Operations will be preferred. Prior experience in event coordination, field surveys, skilling programmes, CSR projects, training administration or data entry is an advantage but not mandatory. 9. KPI: · Batch documentation completeness: All mandatory batch records uploaded or missing items clearly flagged for every assigned batch. · Timely evidence submission: Geo-tagged photos/videos and core evidence uploaded on the training day, subject to connectivity. · Assessment data timeliness: Candidate-wise assessment sheet compiled and shared within the project manager’s prescribed cut-off; delays escalated promptly. · Data accuracy: Participant details, attendance and assessment records cross-checked for missing entries, duplicates and mismatches. · Case-study requirement: Minimum three usable trainee case-study videos per batch, with consent and required discussion points covered. · Daily updates: Accurate status update shared with the reporting manager for each assigned batch/day, including blockers and pending actions. · Audit and compliance: Batch documentation passes internal review/audit; no unauthorised sharing or storage of participant data. Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month Benefits: Flexible schedule Work Location: In person

Support infrastructure requirements for Micro Focus or Rocket Enterprise Server hosting environments. Enable secure integration with enterprise systems, databases, middleware, and external platforms. Collaborate with DevOps teams to integrate cloud infrastructure into CI/CD delivery pipelines. Conduct infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, performance tuning, and environment optimization activities. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Experience supporting mainframe modernization and replatforming programs. Experience with Micro Focus Enterprise Server or Rocket Enterprise Server infrastructure deployments. Exposure to enterprise database platforms and cloud-based database architectures. Experience supporting financial services, banking, insurance, or other highly regulated industries. Knowledge of DevSecOps and cloud security frameworks. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. description: Founded in 1910, KONE is a global leader that provides elevators, escalators and automatic building doors, as well as solutions for maintenance and modernization that add value to buildings throughout their life cycle. KDT unit within KTI is responsible for developing Digital Services products such as KONE 24/7 Connected Services, Residential Flow and Partnership Ecosystem Role purpose We are seeking a Lead Architect to define and govern the end-to-end architecture of our global industrial IoT and digital platform ecosystem . The role connects physical equipment, gateway runtimes, device connectivity, cloud platforms, digital applications, enterprise identity, and AI-enabled capabilities into a coherent, evolvable architecture. The architect will establish architecture-first delivery practices in which business capabilities, quality attributes, system boundaries, contracts, security requirements, and operational models are defined before implementation. You will translate complex technical decisions into clear recommendations for engineering and business stakeholders, connecting choices to customer value, cost, risk, reliability, delivery timelines, and operational readiness. What you will do Own target architectures, system boundaries, contracts, quality requirements, and technical roadmaps. Document alternatives, assumptions, failure modes, and trade-offs before implementation. Design multi-region routing, tenant and workload isolation, data placement, replication, failover and failback. Define RTO, RPO, availability objectives, and recovery validation for each workload. Enable repeatable regional expansion through reusable infrastructure, automated onboarding, configuration-driven deployment, and application designs that avoid regional forks. Govern industrial edge connectivity, device provisioning, certificate lifecycle, offline behavior, secure OTA updates, and command handling with embedded and safety specialists. Architect cloud services, APIs, real-time integrations, messaging, and data platforms with explicit ownership, compatibility, tenant isolation, and failure behavior. Embed security, observability, capacity planning, cost management, upgrade paths, and operational readiness into every architecture. Establish practical architecture standards, ADRs, reusable platform capabilities, repository boundaries, infrastructure as code, and automated delivery checks. Communicate through clear diagrams, business-focused narratives, and decision options. Lead cross-team reviews, mentor engineers, and build trust with stakeholders. Evaluate AI-assisted engineering and AI-enabled applications with specialist teams, considering business value, privacy, permissions, security, limitations, evaluation, and human oversight. PKI, device identity, and cryptographic architecture Architecture focus: PKI is a foundational device trust system, not merely a subtopic within general identity and security. The role must govern identity from factory provisioning through operational use, renewal, revocation, retirement, and long-lived hardware replacement. Define hardware-backed device identity using IEEE 802.1AR concepts, including factory identity and operational identity, with TPM 2.0 or secure-element roots of trust. Design zero-touch enrollment and renewal using appropriate protocols such as EST, SCEP, or CMPv2, with explicit bootstrap, recovery, renewal, revocation, and offline behavior. Author X.509 certificate profiles aligned with RFC 5280, including subject naming, SAN conventions, EKU constraints, key usage, validity periods, policy OIDs, CRL distribution points, and validation rules. Design CA hierarchies, trust domains, signing boundaries, key ceremonies, offline root protection, intermediate CA operations, HSM integration, and delegated issuance. Govern certificate rotation at fleet scale, including clock drift, intermittent connectivity, dual-certificate overlap, compromised-device recovery, factory reset, ownership transfer, and end-of-life handling. Define cryptographic agility and long-term migration strategies for algorithm changes, including assessment of post-quantum standards such as ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA where appropriate. Standards, RFCs, and normative specifications Establish a reference architecture and standards catalogue that distinguishes mandatory requirements from recommendations. Use RFC 2119 and RFC 8174 terminology consistently when writing normative specifications. Use MUST and MUST NOT for binding requirements; use SHOULD and SHOULD NOT for strong recommendations with documented exceptions; use MAY for permitted options. Maintain versioned specifications for identity, certificate profiles, TLS, MQTT topics, API contracts, event schemas, command semantics, error handling, and regional deployment. Reference applicable standards such as RFC 5280 for X.509 certificates, RFC 7030 for EST, RFC 8446 for TLS 1.3, RFC 6455 for WebSockets, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect specifications, OpenAPI, and the OASIS MQTT specification. Use ADRs to record context, decision, alternatives, consequences, security impact, operational impact, and conditions for revisiting the decision. Keep C4, deployment, sequence, threat, and data-flow models versioned with the systems they describe. Required experience 14+ years in software engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or systems architecture, including 6+ years leading architecture for complex enterprise, industrial, or mission-critical systems. Proven production delivery and operational experience with multi-region systems, disaster recovery, incident response, and recovery validation. Strong system design judgment and hands-on ability to validate decisions through prototypes, code reviews, performance testing, load testing, and operational evidence. Demonstrated ability to influence multiple teams and explain technical trade-offs to engineering, product, leadership, and non-technical stakeholders. Experience creating standards and governance that enable delivery rather than introducing unnecessary process. Preferred experience Industrial equipment, fleet management, OT cybersecurity, predictive maintenance, digital twins, or large-scale multi-tenant platforms. Platform engineering, technology modernization, and practical exposure to AI-assisted development or enterprise AI integration. Experience with long-lived devices, constrained connectivity, safety-related command paths, and supplier or partner integration. Certifications Certifications are desirable but not mandatory. They do not replace demonstrated system design expertise and production experience. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or AWS Certified Security – Specialty. Certified Kubernetes Administrator or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist. TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture qualification. Relevant Microsoft identity, security, industrial cybersecurity, or cryptography certifications. What success looks like Architecture decisions are clear, trusted, documented, and adopted by delivery teams. Multi-region applications meet agreed availability, RTO, and RPO objectives, with recovery regularly tested. Device identity and PKI operations are automated, observable, recoverable, and secure throughout the asset lifecycle. Platforms remain secure, operable, and maintainable as devices, tenants, integrations, and capabilities grow. Normative standards and reusable platform capabilities reduce duplication, incompatible changes, and operational toil. AI experimentation is practical, governed, privacy-aware, and separated from unsafe or unverified control of physical equipment. description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. About the role We're hiring a Technical Support Specialist in Bengaluru to be the technical line of support between our customers and engineering. Our software helps US electric utilities prepare for and respond to emergencies like major storms — when it doesn't work, crews and the public feel it. You'll take escalated issues, find out what's really going on, fix what you can, and hand engineering a clean, well-diagnosed problem when you can't. You'll work closely with our customer support team, engineers, Product and your manager, and help shape how support runs as we grow. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own escalated customer issues end to end — triage, reproduce, diagnose, resolve or hand off, and close the loop with the customer. Diagnose. Dig into logs, data and configuration to find the real cause, not just the symptom. Clean escalations. When engineering needs to fix something, hand over a reproducible issue with evidence, impact and priority — so it gets fixed fast. Storm-ready. Be ready for peak events, when customers lean on us hardest, and keep calm and clear communication flowing. Fix the pattern. Spot recurring issues, write knowledge-base articles and runbooks, and push for product fixes that remove whole categories of tickets. Voice of the customer. Bring what you learn from customers back to Product and Engineering so it shapes what we build next. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 3–4 years in technical support, application support or production support for a software product. You troubleshoot from evidence. You've diagnosed real production issues using logs, SQL and APIs — not only scripts and FAQs. You write clearly. Your tickets, customer updates and escalations are short, precise and easy to act on, for both customers and engineers. You stay calm under pressure. You've handled urgent, high-visibility issues and kept customers informed while you worked them. You work with minimal handholding. You take an issue, work it to the end, and know when and how to escalate. Availability: comfortable working hours that overlap with US customers. Sense of Urgency : Knows the importance of resolving customer issue asap or knowns when to escalate and when to protect engineering Team Bandwidth. We care how you solve problems more than which ticketing tool you used. Technical background You've supported web-based software running in the cloud, with hands-on skills such as: SQL: you write queries confidently to investigate data issues and verify fixes. APIs: you can call and debug REST APIs with tools such as Postman or curl, and read request and response payloads. Logs and monitoring: you've searched logs and dashboards in tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk or Kibana to trace an issue. Cloud: working knowledge of AWS or another cloud — enough to understand where a service runs and what can fail. Scripting: basic Python, Bash or similar to automate checks and repetitive fixes. Support tooling: ticketing and incident tools such as Jira, Zendesk, Freshdesk or PagerDuty, and the discipline of SLAs and priorities. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. Resolution time went down, escalations to engineering dropped, or a recurring issue disappeared — and you can say what you did. A hard case, told in detail. An issue others gave up on that you traced to its root cause across logs, data and code. Ticket killers. You've turned repeat issues into a runbook, a script, a KB article or a product fix, so they stopped coming in. Incident experience. You've been part of a major outage or peak event and helped keep customers informed while it was fixed. Trusted by engineers. Developers took your escalations seriously because your diagnosis was usually right. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You treat every ticket as a customer who can't do their job, and you follow up until it's actually solved. Impact over activity. You measure success by problems solved and tickets prevented, not tickets touched. Honesty. You tell customers what you know and what you don't, never promise what engineering hasn't committed, and own your mistakes. Independence. You don't wait to be told what to do next. You work an issue to the end with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a tool you built to make support faster, a product you learned inside out, things you taught others. Depth. At least one product you've supported well enough to explain how it works under the hood and where it usually breaks. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! Global Manufacturing comprises a core group of functions that contribute to the production and supply of high-quality products: Engineering; Manufacturing Information & Control Systems; Quality & Labs, Technology Services/Manufacturing Science; Global Health, Safety and Environment; and Global Supply Chain. Key Responsibilities OT Platform Excellence: Develop and maintain IoT ecosystems ensuring uptime, and scalable evolution to support manufacturing growth Developing and implement comprehensive IoT solutions including edge device management Deployment of end-to-end IoT platforms from proof-of-concept through production validation and ongoing lifecycle management Availability of OT S95 L3 data and L4/Cloud IT data for Agentic architecture. Cloud-Native Application Development: Docker & Containers – Building, running, and managing containers & images Establish and enforce containerization best practices, automated CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code principles for rapid, reliable deployments Partner with cross-functional teams to enable OT application integration, automated testing, and continuous delivery workflows Data Streaming & Integration: Implementing data ingestion pipelines using Apache Kafka, MQTT brokers, and Azure Event Hub to process manufacturing telemetry Ensure seamless OT/IT integration through secure, compliant SAE approved patterns that maintains manufacturing system integrity Develop real-time analytics solutions that transform OT data streams into actionable insights for production optimization and predictive maintenance Knowledge Sharing, Training & Documentation: Maintain detailed runbooks, architecture diagrams, deployment documentation, and SOPs. Education Requirements: Bachelors in Computer Science/IT, or Engineering (or equivalent work experience) Skills/requirements: 4 - 8-year manufacturing experience with deep knowledge of validation protocols, and manufacturing systems Proven track record of development & implementing solutions in regulated environments with understanding of data integrity, and audit trail requirements Hands-on experience with APIM and OpenShift/Kubernetes including container orchestration Troubleshooting, Debugging & resolving containerized apps, basic monitoring & logging Experience in Programming/scripting skills, Git, CI/CD pipelines Experience in bridging OT/IT systems while maintaining network segmentation and industrial cybersecurity best practices Experience with Azure and AWS Cloud platforms Preferred Knowledge on Apache Kafka ecosystem, stream processing frameworks, and real-time data pipeline optimization for high-volume manufacturing data Understanding of DevSecOps practices, infrastructure automation, and monitoring solutions for production environments Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and GxP knowledge preferred Travel may be required to other Manufacturing sites in US and/or Europe. title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Networking, Hybrid Connectivity
description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 5 years of experience programming in C++, Java, Go or Python. 3 years of experience developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture. 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. Preferred qualifications: Experience with Software Defined Networking, Security, Networking, within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other public clouds like Cloud Computing Platform. Experience with system automation, automated testing, or continuous deployment pipelines in a production environment. Experience diagnosing and resolving complex, systemic troubleshooting issues in distributed control plane systems. Ability to clearly communicate complex technical designs and collaborate effectively with adjacent engineering, product, and SRE teams. About the job Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. The Hybrid Connectivity Bengaluru team designs, builds, and scales the foundational control planes, distributed workflows, and software-defined routing infrastructure that bridge external networks to Google Cloud. We deliver zero-friction, mission-critical hybrid connectivity (Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN, and Cloud Router) through resilient, modern control-plane architectures (Arcus/Hybrid CLH), empowering global enterprises to connect to Google Cloud with predictable performance, carrier-grade reliability, and defense-in-depth security.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Responsibilities Drive technical initiatives for the Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN, and Cloud Router control plane within the Bengaluru Hybrid Connectivity team. Own end-to-end design, implementation, and deployment of reliable, scalable control-plane components and features. Design and develop high-throughput, low-latency control-plane software for Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN, and Cloud Router. Translate product requirements into technical designs, ensuring seamless integration with Google Cloud's hybrid networking infrastructure. Diagnose control-plane issues across distributed routing and virtual private network systems. Enhance observability, sub-second route convergence, fault tolerance, and system uptime to maintain enterprise-grade Service-Level Agreements (SLAs). Partner with Product Management, SRE, and partner engineering teams across global and local Bengaluru sites to align on technical dependencies and deliver high-performance hybrid connectivity solutions. Write clean and maintainable code in C++, Go, or Python. Streamline control-plane testing and operational workflows while mentoring engineers. title: Platform Engineer- Azure
description: Platform Engineer (Azure) Work Mode: Hybrid Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time Experience: 5+ Years Role Summary: We are looking for an experienced Azure Platform Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Azure infrastructure, cloud platform engineering, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD, and identity and security management. The role involves taking end-to-end ownership of the Azure cloud platform, including infrastructure, deployment pipelines, development and testing environments, security, and operational monitoring. The ideal candidate should have strong experience designing, implementing, and managing secure, scalable Azure environments using Bicep, Azure DevOps, Docker, and Microsoft Entra ID. This is a hands-on engineering role requiring someone who can independently manage the complete cloud infrastructure lifecycle, automate deployments, troubleshoot configuration issues, and ensure platform reliability, security, and performance. Work Schedule: The selected candidate will be required to work in Australian business hours. Key Responsibilities: Own and manage end-to-end Azure cloud infrastructure, including Azure Container Apps, Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Key Vault, Azure Front Door, WAF, virtual networks, private endpoints, and private DNS. Design, implement, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep, ensuring infrastructure deployments are automated, consistent, and scalable. Manage Azure infrastructure security through managed identities, network isolation, least-privilege access, and secure secrets management. Own the complete deployment lifecycle using Azure Developer CLI (azd), including environment configuration, Bicep parameters, and application settings. Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps YAML pipelines or GitHub Actions. Manage Docker and Linux container builds, including container images with native dependencies. Build, configure, and maintain development, testing, demonstration, and sandbox environments. Manage Microsoft Entra ID, including app registrations, service principals, application permissions, admin consent, certificates, and secret rotation. Ensure secure authentication and authorization using managed identities and Microsoft Entra ID. Monitor and maintain cloud infrastructure using Azure Application Insights, Log Analytics, alerting, and health monitoring. Manage infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, performance optimization, and Azure cloud costs. Troubleshoot deployment failures, infrastructure configuration issues, and application connectivity problems. Maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, and security compliance evidence. Collaborate with application engineering teams to ensure seamless integration between the cloud platform and application services. Qualifications Required: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Azure infrastructure and cloud platform engineering. Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), preferably using Bicep . Experience with Terraform or ARM templates is also acceptable, provided the candidate is comfortable working with Bicep. Hands-on experience with Azure services, including: Azure Container Apps or AKS. Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Azure Key Vault. Azure Front Door and Web Application Firewall (WAF). Virtual Networks (VNet), Private Endpoints, and Private DNS Zones. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, including App Registrations, Service Principals, Managed Identities, App-only permissions, Delegated Permissions, and Admin Consent. Experience with Azure DevOps YAML pipelines or GitHub Actions and CI/CD automation. Strong understanding of Docker, Linux containerization, and container image builds. Hands-on experience with Azure CLI, Azure Developer CLI (azd), and PowerShell or Bash scripting. Basic to intermediate knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js to troubleshoot application configurations and make minor code-level changes. Experience managing cloud deployments, environment configurations, secrets, and application settings. Strong understanding of cloud security, network isolation, identity management, and access controls. Experience with infrastructure monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and operational support. Ability to independently own cloud infrastructure, deployment processes, and platform operations. Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Willingness to work in Australian business hours. Good-to-Have Skills: Microsoft certifications such as AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert), AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert), or AZ-104 (Azure Administrator). Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Dataverse environment management, Managed Environments, and PAC CLI. Knowledge of Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations environments and Lifecycle Services (LCS). Experience with Microsoft Graph app-only access and SharePoint tenant administration. Exposure to Microsoft Fabric and Power BI workspace administration. Knowledge of FinOps and Azure cost management. Experience working in consultancy or software product environments. Exposure to security assessments, penetration testing remediation, Essential Eight, or ISO 27001.

title: Senior Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – Full Stack
description: Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Job Purpose The Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – Full Stack builds and runs the Internal Hosting Portal that allows application teams across GSK to provision and manage Cloud resources in a self-service manner. The Hosting Portal is a custom-built web application using a modern TypeScript tech stack based on TypeScript. The full stack engineer sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through autoamted software deployment rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. Key Responsibilities Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. Professional Qualifications Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). Area of Specialisation Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. Experience Required Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with HTML5, CSS3 (including preprocessors) and TypeScript (ES6+). Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with React and NextJS Hands-on experience with GraphQL and relevant tooling such as Yoga, Prisma, and Apollo Client undefined Good understanding of bundlers and compilers such as Webpack, TS-Node, Rspack and Babel. undefined Previous experience in developing a React-based UI Component library based on Mantine, Material UI, or Chakra UI. undefined Familiar with popular patterns and libraries such as React Hooks, state management, and Redux. undefined Previously developed schema-based forms either custom or based on a library such as react-hook-form or Formik, including data validator libraries such as Yup, Zod or JOI. undefined Expertise with CSS grid systems, media queries, flex and other layout techniques and responsive user interface components. undefined Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth v2 or SAML and JSON Web Token and libraries such as MSAL. Strong experience with test automation (unit & integration) tools such as Jest and Cypress. Desirable: Familiar with building React web applications based on a Micro Frontend using Module Federation or Single SPA. undefined Developed REST APIs based on NodeJS (ExpressJS). undefined Experience of building and deploying web applications through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. undefined Knowledge of deploying, managing and monitoring web applications in a Cloud environment such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud. undefined Previously worked in a central IT team within a regulated environment such as the Pharmaceutical or Finance industry. Skills/Background Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. #AGTech Skills API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Deployment, Cloud Financial Operations, Component Libraries, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Full Stack Development, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Quality Engineering, Secure Authentication, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Test Automation, Virtualization Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. Perform root cause analysis and implement preventative improvements that increase reliability, recoverability, and operational supportability. Optimize cloud consumption while protecting customer experience, platform performance, and service resilience. Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, security, performance, maintainability, and compliance. Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to routing, self-service, agent support, analytics, and engineering productivity. Use customer feedback, operational insights, and platform telemetry to continuously improve solutions. Participate in code and design reviews and follow established engineering standards. Apply secure coding, privacy, data protection, cloud security, and enterprise compliance requirements throughout the solution lifecycle. Demonstrate end-to-end ownership from design through production support and continuous improvement. Experience with contact center technologies or customer experience platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, Five9, Cisco, or comparable platforms. Experience integrating contact center channels, routing, agent workflows, customer self-service, or interaction data with enterprise applications and services. Experience with Lambda, TypeScript or a comparable development language, API design, event-driven architecture, and Infrastructure as Code. Experience supporting production services through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, and root cause analysis. Creates reusable AWS services and patterns that accelerate delivery across the Customer Experience Platform. Balances customer experience, delivery speed, operational reliability, security, cost, and long-term architectural integrity. Uses AI-assisted engineering practices responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and innovation. Creates momentum by sharing knowledge, challenging assumptions, and partnering across Connect, cloud, product, and operations teams.
