title: Technical Support Specialist
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. About the role We're hiring a Technical Support Specialist in Bengaluru to be the technical line of support between our customers and engineering. Our software helps US electric utilities prepare for and respond to emergencies like major storms — when it doesn't work, crews and the public feel it. You'll take escalated issues, find out what's really going on, fix what you can, and hand engineering a clean, well-diagnosed problem when you can't. You'll work closely with our customer support team, engineers, Product and your manager, and help shape how support runs as we grow. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own escalated customer issues end to end — triage, reproduce, diagnose, resolve or hand off, and close the loop with the customer. Diagnose. Dig into logs, data and configuration to find the real cause, not just the symptom. Clean escalations. When engineering needs to fix something, hand over a reproducible issue with evidence, impact and priority — so it gets fixed fast. Storm-ready. Be ready for peak events, when customers lean on us hardest, and keep calm and clear communication flowing. Fix the pattern. Spot recurring issues, write knowledge-base articles and runbooks, and push for product fixes that remove whole categories of tickets. Voice of the customer. Bring what you learn from customers back to Product and Engineering so it shapes what we build next. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 3–4 years in technical support, application support or production support for a software product. You troubleshoot from evidence. You've diagnosed real production issues using logs, SQL and APIs — not only scripts and FAQs. You write clearly. Your tickets, customer updates and escalations are short, precise and easy to act on, for both customers and engineers. You stay calm under pressure. You've handled urgent, high-visibility issues and kept customers informed while you worked them. You work with minimal handholding. You take an issue, work it to the end, and know when and how to escalate. Availability: comfortable working hours that overlap with US customers. Sense of Urgency : Knows the importance of resolving customer issue asap or knowns when to escalate and when to protect engineering Team Bandwidth. We care how you solve problems more than which ticketing tool you used. Technical background You've supported web-based software running in the cloud, with hands-on skills such as: SQL: you write queries confidently to investigate data issues and verify fixes. APIs: you can call and debug REST APIs with tools such as Postman or curl, and read request and response payloads. Logs and monitoring: you've searched logs and dashboards in tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk or Kibana to trace an issue. Cloud: working knowledge of AWS or another cloud — enough to understand where a service runs and what can fail. Scripting: basic Python, Bash or similar to automate checks and repetitive fixes. Support tooling: ticketing and incident tools such as Jira, Zendesk, Freshdesk or PagerDuty, and the discipline of SLAs and priorities. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. Resolution time went down, escalations to engineering dropped, or a recurring issue disappeared — and you can say what you did. A hard case, told in detail. An issue others gave up on that you traced to its root cause across logs, data and code. Ticket killers. You've turned repeat issues into a runbook, a script, a KB article or a product fix, so they stopped coming in. Incident experience. You've been part of a major outage or peak event and helped keep customers informed while it was fixed. Trusted by engineers. Developers took your escalations seriously because your diagnosis was usually right. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You treat every ticket as a customer who can't do their job, and you follow up until it's actually solved. Impact over activity. You measure success by problems solved and tickets prevented, not tickets touched. Honesty. You tell customers what you know and what you don't, never promise what engineering hasn't committed, and own your mistakes. Independence. You don't wait to be told what to do next. You work an issue to the end with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a tool you built to make support faster, a product you learned inside out, things you taught others. Depth. At least one product you've supported well enough to explain how it works under the hood and where it usually breaks. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Solid understanding of SharePoint Online permissions, the sharing model, site architecture and OneDrive administration. title: Data Analyst I
description: Company Description At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. Job Description Support consulting projects and client deliverables Collaborate with colleagues in the consulting team to jointly deliver high-quality work to our clients on various projects related to rights holders’ commercial strategies, media rights, fan development and brands’ sponsorship planning. Conduct independent analysis of internal and external data sets, drawing out insights and producing recommendations and strategies. Develop and deliver compelling presentations to communicate project results effectively to clients and key stakeholders. Analyze information independently and present findings to clients alongside experienced team members. Manage simple to medium projects and work under guidance on complex projects Use project planning, project management and capacity planning tools (such as Monday.com) to plan, implement and track projects. Build productive day-to-day relationships with clients Develop strong client relationships – we are a non-hierarchical team and believe in all consultants engaging regularly with our clients. Become a trusted advisor and collaborate with clients to understand their business objectives, challenges and needs. Continue your professional development Keep up to date with trends in the sports and entertainment industries. Use Nielsen’s broad range of learning and development resources to further your commercial expertise. Support team planning and process management. Build expertise in Nielsen Sports tools and the product portfolio, continuously expanding your knowledge of clients, the sports business landscape, and the media and advertising industry. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or equivalent) in business administration, sports management or a related field. 1 –2 year of experience post Master’s as a strategy and/or management consultant at a top consulting firm. Excellent communication skills to present recommendations to different audiences, with strong problem-definition and story lining skills. Ability to think creatively and strategically, and to undertake data analysis to solve problems. Analytical mindset, with the ability to identify client needs. Good time management and prioritization skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel. Fluency in English (written and spoken). A passion for sport and an interest in the commercial business of sport. Knowledge of media and sponsorship, and an understanding of the global media and sports ecosystem, how it is measured, and how advertisers, media, platforms and fans interact. Additional Information Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

The person is expected to be hands-on with complex insurance analysis while providing functional guidance and mentoring to the broader BA organization. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Insurance Domain Expertise and Functional Leadership  Act as a subject matter expert in US P&C insurance business processes, products, and workflows.  Interpret complex insurance product documentation, policy forms, rating manuals, underwriting guidelines, and regulatory requirements.  Develop a deep understanding of insurance product structures, coverages, limits, deductibles, endorsements, exclusions, and policy conditions.  Understand insurance product configuration, rating methodologies, underwriting rules, and policy lifecycle processes.  Provide functional guidance to Business Analysts, Product Managers, Architects, and Engineering teams.  Identify missing, ambiguous, contradictory, or incomplete insurance requirements.  Validate functional interpretations against insurance business practices and applicable source documentation.  Establish standardized insurance terminology, definitions, and reusable functional reference models.  Act as a point of escalation for complex insurance domain questions and functional interpretation. B. Complex Business Analysis and Requirement Management  Independently lead complex business analysis initiatives from discovery through functional specification and validation.  Conduct requirement discovery workshops with customers, business stakeholders, product teams, and internal SMEs.  Analyse business requirements and convert them into detailed functional specifications.  Define business processes, functional workflows, business rules, field metadata, dependencies, and validations.  Develop detailed user stories, epics, acceptance criteria, and functional requirement documents.  Identify functional gaps, process exceptions, business dependencies, and edge cases.  Evaluate the impact of requirement changes across products, workflows, rating, underwriting, forms, and integrations.  Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, traceable, and implementation-ready.  Independently manage complex requirements without continuous supervision from existing senior BAs.  Review and validate functional deliverables prepared by junior and intermediate BAs. C. Insurance Product Definition and Configuration  Lead functional analysis of insurance product definitions and product configuration requirements.  Translate insurance product manuals and related documents into structured product definitions.  Define product hierarchy, product attributes, coverages, limits, deductibles, rating factors, and underwriting conditions.  Analyse insurance rating methodologies, rating tables, factors, formulas, modifiers, and calculation dependencies.  Interpret state-specific insurance variations, product exceptions, and applicability rules.  Define policy forms, endorsements, form applicability, and document-related functional requirements.  Identify statistical coding and regulatory reporting requirements where applicable.  Ensure insurance product definitions are consistent across source documents and functional specifications.  Work with platform specialists to determine how insurance product concepts should be represented in Solartis.  Identify reusable product capabilities versus customer-specific requirements. D. Solartis Platform Functional Expertise  Develop a comprehensive understanding of Solartis platform capabilities, architecture, configuration mechanisms, and functional workflows.  Understand how insurance products are represented and configured within the Solartis platform.  Analyse product requirements against existing platform functionality and configuration options.  Identify standard platform capabilities, configuration opportunities, extension requirements, and functional gaps.  Work with solution architects and engineering leads to validate functional feasibility.  Help define reusable configuration patterns and standardized functional implementation approaches.  Maintain functional documentation covering platform capabilities, limitations, dependencies, and implementation patterns.  Support platform knowledge transfer to new BAs and other engineering teams.  Participate in functional design reviews, solution walkthroughs, and product acceptance activities. E. Product Management Support and Product Capability Development  Collaborate with Product Managers to evaluate customer requirements and identify opportunities for common product capabilities.  Identify recurring customer requirements that can be converted into reusable platform features.  Provide functional inputs for product roadmap planning and backlog prioritization.  Evaluate the business impact, functional complexity, dependencies, and implementation implications of proposed features.  Challenge requirements that introduce unnecessary customization or duplicate existing functionality.  Contribute to product capability documentation, functional specifications, and feature acceptance criteria.  Support product demonstrations and functional walkthroughs when required.  Help maintain alignment between customer requirements, product strategy, and platform capabilities. F. Business Analyst Mentoring and Capability Development  Act as a functional mentor for junior and intermediate Business Analysts.  Guide BAs in insurance domain understanding, requirement analysis, functional documentation, and platform knowledge.  Conduct regular knowledge-sharing sessions on P&C insurance concepts and Solartis platform capabilities.  Review BA deliverables and provide structured feedback.  Establish templates, standards, checklists, and functional documentation guidelines.  Create reusable examples of insurance product definitions, business rules, rating specifications, and workflows.  Develop practical learning paths and competency assessments for junior BAs.  Gradually enable junior BAs to independently handle standard and moderately complex requirements.  Reduce dependency on existing senior BAs for routine requirement clarification and functional reviews. G. AI-Assisted Business Analysis and Knowledge Management  Collaborate with AI Engineering teams to identify opportunities to automate repetitive business analysis activities.  Provide insurance domain expertise for AI-assisted insurance document understanding and product digitization.  Define expected extraction structures for insurance products, coverages, rating factors, underwriting rules, and forms.  Validate AI-generated insurance product definitions and functional requirements.  Help establish canonical insurance data models, business terminology, and domain taxonomies.  Define business validation rules and exception scenarios for AI-generated outputs.  Contribute to AI-assisted requirements generation, test case generation, and functional validation workflows.  Help create an approved insurance domain knowledge repository containing validated business concepts, examples, and reusable functional patterns.  Ensure that AI-generated insurance interpretations are traceable to source documents and validated by authorized domain experts. 3. Insurance Domain Knowledge – Mandatory / Strongly Preferred Strong experience in US P&C insurance is highly preferred. The candidate should have substantial knowledge of: Insurance Product and Policy Lifecycle  Property & Casualty insurance products.  Policy administration and policy lifecycle management.  Quote, rating, underwriting, binding, issuance, endorsement, renewal, and cancellation.  Carrier, MGA, broker, and agent operating models. Insurance Product Configuration  Product definitions and product structures.  Coverages, limits, deductibles, exclusions, and endorsements.  Insurance forms and form applicability.  State-specific product variations.  Product eligibility and underwriting rules. Rating and Underwriting  Insurance rating methodologies.  Rating factors, rating tables, and calculation rules.  Premium calculation and rating dependencies.  Underwriting eligibility, referrals, restrictions, and exceptions.  Risk classification and rating-related data requirements. Insurance Documentation and Compliance  Insurance product manuals.  Rating manuals.  Underwriting guidelines.  Policy forms and endorsements.  State-specific supplements and regulatory requirements.  Statistical coding and insurance reporting requirements.  Familiarity with ACORD standards is an advantage. Experience with US insurance carriers, MGAs, policy administration platforms, rating engines, and insurance product configuration solutions will be particularly valuable. 4. Technical and Functional Knowledge  Strong understanding of enterprise insurance technology platforms.  Experience with product configuration and policy administration systems.  Understanding of business rules engines, rating engines, workflow engines, and integration concepts.  Ability to understand APIs, data structures, JSON, XML, and database concepts.  Experience working with Agile product development and software engineering teams.  Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, and requirement management tools.  Ability to interpret technical architecture and evaluate functional implications.  Awareness of AI/ML, GenAI, RAG, and document intelligence applications in insurance technology.  Experience working with structured metadata, data dictionaries, and canonical data models. 5. Experience and Qualifications Mandatory:  12–18 years of overall professional experience in insurance, InsurTech, or enterprise technology.  Significant experience in Business Analysis, Insurance Product Analysis, or Insurance Functional Consulting.  Strong hands-on experience in US P&C insurance business processes.  Proven experience independently handling complex insurance requirements.  Experience translating insurance business needs into detailed functional specifications.  Experience with insurance product configuration, rating, underwriting, and policy lifecycle processes.  Strong stakeholder communication and requirement management skills.  Demonstrated experience mentoring or reviewing the work of other BAs. Preferred:  Experience with insurance SaaS platforms and policy administration systems.  Experience with rating engines and insurance product configuration platforms.  Experience with US insurance carriers, MGAs, or insurance technology vendors.  Previous experience as an Insurance Product Specialist, Lead BA, Business Architect, or Insurance Functional Consultant.  Experience with Solartis or similar insurance technology platforms.  Experience supporting product modernization and digital transformation initiatives.  Exposure to AI-driven insurance product digitization and document intelligence.

title: Senior QC/R&D
description: Company Description Sika is a speciality chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industrial manufacturing. Sika has subsidiaries in 102 countries around the world and, in over 400 factories, produces innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation sector towards greater environmental compatibility. With more than 34,000 employees, the company generated sales of CHF 11.76 billion in 2024. Job Description Job Purpose Lead the Quality Control and Research and Development functions to ensure consistent product quality, develop and improve construction chemical formulations, and support efficient manufacturing. Drive innovation, cost optimization, and technical problem-solving while ensuring that products meet approved specifications, customer requirements, applicable standards, and Sika’s technical and safety requirements. Key Responsibilities 1. Quality Control and Product Conformity Manage the inspection and testing of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediate products, and finished goods against approved specifications. Establish and maintain sampling plans, testing methods, acceptance criteria, and traceable quality records. Oversee material and finished-product release decisions within delegated authority, ensuring that nonconforming materials are identified, segregated, and controlled. Investigate quality deviations, batch failures, and recurring defects with Production and other relevant functions; verify the effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions. Monitor quality trends and recommend improvements to product consistency, testing reliability, and manufacturing processes. 2. Research and Product Development Lead the development, localization, and improvement of construction chemical products within the assigned portfolio. Translate market needs and customer requirements into defined development projects with Sales, Marketing, and Technical teams. Plan laboratory experiments, performance evaluations, application trials, and stability studies to validate new and modified formulations. Coordinate with Sika’s regional and global R&D teams on technology transfer, technical approvals, and knowledge sharing. Maintain a prioritized development pipeline with clear objectives, responsibilities, milestones, and progress reporting. 3. Raw Materials and Formulation Optimization Evaluate alternative raw materials and suppliers with Procurement to improve supply continuity, product performance, and cost efficiency. Lead formulation optimization initiatives while maintaining required quality, safety, application performance, and shelf life. Ensure that material substitutions and formulation changes are tested, documented, and approved before implementation. Support initiatives to reduce waste and environmental impact, with appropriate technical validation of resulting product claims. 4. Production Support and Industrialization Lead the technical transfer of approved formulations from laboratory trials to pilot and commercial production. Establish manufacturing instructions, process parameters, and quality checkpoints with Production. Support troubleshooting of processing difficulties and product performance issues, identifying sustainable technical solutions. Work with Technical Service and Sales to investigate customer complaints, conduct relevant testing, and recommend corrective actions. Provide technical training on product characteristics, testing requirements, and manufacturing controls. 5. Laboratory Management and Safety Manage laboratory capacity, workloads, equipment, consumables, and testing priorities to support production and development requirements. Ensure that instruments are calibrated, maintained, and suitable for their intended tests. Maintain effective sample identification, retention, storage, and disposal arrangements. Ensure safe laboratory practices, chemical handling, housekeeping, and waste management in coordination with EHS. Maintain reliable and complete experimental records and test results. 6. Quality Systems and Technical Documentation Maintain controlled formulations, specifications, test methods, manufacturing instructions, and technical records. Ensure that approved formulation changes are accurately reflected in bills of materials and relevant systems. Support ISO 9001 requirements and applicable internal, customer, certification, and regulatory audits. Coordinate product testing and certification against applicable Egyptian and international standards. Support accurate product data, safety documentation, and labelling with the responsible functions. Protect confidential formulations, technical information, and intellectual property. 7. People Leadership and Department Management Set objectives, allocate responsibilities, and monitor the performance of QC and R&D employees. Coach and develop the team, assess technical competencies, and maintain training and succession plans. Prepare and control departmental budgets, including testing expenses, equipment requirements, and development resources. Report quality performance, development progress, savings, resource needs, and significant technical risks to management. Maintain effective coordination with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, EHS, Finance, and HR. Qualifications Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Suggested experience: at least eight years in construction chemicals or a closely related manufacturing sector, including three years in a managerial or supervisory role. Demonstrated experience in both formulation development and quality control. Strong knowledge of relevant product technologies, laboratory testing, industrial scale-up, and root-cause analysis. Working knowledge of ISO 9001, applicable product standards, and laboratory safety. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant ERP or laboratory systems; SAP experience is an advantage. Strong communication skills in English and Arabic. Additional Information We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

Processes • Manage the Book of Work, ensuring effective prioritization and alignment with stakeholder timelines. • Oversee and streamline processes related to information controls, productivity, and regional/country enhancements, including workflows and procedures. • Manage the product backlog and collaborate with technology teams to digitize client and internal operational workflows for onboarding. • Review and approve use case scenarios and test cases; coordinate and support user acceptance testing and production verification. • Ensure governance and compliance with all bank risk assessments and policies. • Own and approve CADM data usage and define/manage data access for CADM users; strategize and implement identity and access management applications, ensuring no toxic access. • Collaborate with regional and country digital teams to gather product customizations, facilitate country adoption, and support documentation, guidelines, and training for identity and access management tools. • Collect and analyze data to inform product direction and define enhancements to attract new clients. • Deliver the digital strategy for client channel onboarding, ensuring global scalability while accommodating local requirements. • Act as a people influencer and product owner to deliver proof of concepts and execute incubation ideas across business lines and locations, ensuring governance and controls. • Develop and implement plans to increase awareness of digital transformation within client channel onboarding. • Define and drive training programs to enhance digital automation capabilities among channel operations staff and stakeholders. • Identify and address inefficiencies in channel operations, proposing workflow optimizations. • Leverage data analysis to inform decisions and improve operational metrics. • Identify and mitigate risks in channel operations. • Partner with operations and business units to streamline processes, mitigate risks, and drive efficiencies. • Measure and evaluate outcomes of change initiatives post-implementation. • Assess the impact of process changes to ensure no additional manual touchpoints are introduced. People & Talent The role is not a people leader role however the role involves coordination between multiple parties • Work Closely with channel operations team, business teams, peer product owners, engineering lead, architects to define and implement Solutions. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for successful implementation and deployment of client channel onboarding capabilities • Engage actively with legal and compliance to raise awareness of new product features and secure acceptance of the changes. Risk Management • Ensure adherence to risk management framework. • Act as the risk control owner under the Group’s risk management framework at the appropriate level. • Ensure that bank is not exposed to risks due to client channel onboarding data management by enforcing role-based access control, embed market specific data localization as part of the product design. description: Job Description Principal Business Analyst – Insurance Domain & Product Specialist Location: Chennai, India Experience: 12–18 Years Function: Product Engineering / Business Analysis / Insurance Domain Employment Type: Full-time Domain Preference: US Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance / InsurTech 1. Role Overview Techfully is looking for a highly experienced Principal Business Analyst – Insurance Domain & Product Specialist to strengthen its insurance domain expertise, product analysis capabilities, and functional delivery excellence. The individual will play a critical role in bridging the gap between complex insurance business requirements, Solartis platform capabilities, product configuration, and engineering implementation. The role requires a combination of deep insurance domain expertise, strong business analysis capabilities, product functional knowledge, and the ability to independently lead complex requirements and product definition initiatives. The successful candidate will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Customer Engineering, QA, and AI Engineering teams to translate insurance business concepts into structured product definitions, functional specifications, business rules, workflows, validations, and implementation-ready requirements. An important part of this role is to build organizational knowledge and improve the competency of junior Business Analysts through mentoring, structured knowledge sharing, functional reviews, and reusable documentation. This is a senior individual-contributor and functional leadership role. The person is expected to be hands-on with complex insurance analysis while providing functional guidance and mentoring to the broader BA organization. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Insurance Domain Expertise and Functional Leadership  Act as a subject matter expert in US P&C insurance business processes, products, and workflows.  Interpret complex insurance product documentation, policy forms, rating manuals, underwriting guidelines, and regulatory requirements.  Develop a deep understanding of insurance product structures, coverages, limits, deductibles, endorsements, exclusions, and policy conditions.  Understand insurance product configuration, rating methodologies, underwriting rules, and policy lifecycle processes.  Provide functional guidance to Business Analysts, Product Managers, Architects, and Engineering teams.  Identify missing, ambiguous, contradictory, or incomplete insurance requirements.  Validate functional interpretations against insurance business practices and applicable source documentation.  Establish standardized insurance terminology, definitions, and reusable functional reference models.  Act as a point of escalation for complex insurance domain questions and functional interpretation. B. Complex Business Analysis and Requirement Management  Independently lead complex business analysis initiatives from discovery through functional specification and validation.  Conduct requirement discovery workshops with customers, business stakeholders, product teams, and internal SMEs.  Analyse business requirements and convert them into detailed functional specifications.  Define business processes, functional workflows, business rules, field metadata, dependencies, and validations.  Develop detailed user stories, epics, acceptance criteria, and functional requirement documents.  Identify functional gaps, process exceptions, business dependencies, and edge cases.  Evaluate the impact of requirement changes across products, workflows, rating, underwriting, forms, and integrations.  Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, traceable, and implementation-ready.  Independently manage complex requirements without continuous supervision from existing senior BAs.  Review and validate functional deliverables prepared by junior and intermediate BAs. C. Insurance Product Definition and Configuration  Lead functional analysis of insurance product definitions and product configuration requirements.  Translate insurance product manuals and related documents into structured product definitions.  Define product hierarchy, product attributes, coverages, limits, deductibles, rating factors, and underwriting conditions.  Analyse insurance rating methodologies, rating tables, factors, formulas, modifiers, and calculation dependencies.  Interpret state-specific insurance variations, product exceptions, and applicability rules.  Define policy forms, endorsements, form applicability, and document-related functional requirements.  Identify statistical coding and regulatory reporting requirements where applicable.  Ensure insurance product definitions are consistent across source documents and functional specifications.  Work with platform specialists to determine how insurance product concepts should be represented in Solartis.  Identify reusable product capabilities versus customer-specific requirements. D. Solartis Platform Functional Expertise  Develop a comprehensive understanding of Solartis platform capabilities, architecture, configuration mechanisms, and functional workflows.  Understand how insurance products are represented and configured within the Solartis platform.  Analyse product requirements against existing platform functionality and configuration options.  Identify standard platform capabilities, configuration opportunities, extension requirements, and functional gaps.  Work with solution architects and engineering leads to validate functional feasibility.  Help define reusable configuration patterns and standardized functional implementation approaches.  Maintain functional documentation covering platform capabilities, limitations, dependencies, and implementation patterns.  Support platform knowledge transfer to new BAs and other engineering teams.  Participate in functional design reviews, solution walkthroughs, and product acceptance activities. E. Product Management Support and Product Capability Development  Collaborate with Product Managers to evaluate customer requirements and identify opportunities for common product capabilities.  Identify recurring customer requirements that can be converted into reusable platform features.  Provide functional inputs for product roadmap planning and backlog prioritization.  Evaluate the business impact, functional complexity, dependencies, and implementation implications of proposed features.  Challenge requirements that introduce unnecessary customization or duplicate existing functionality.  Contribute to product capability documentation, functional specifications, and feature acceptance criteria.  Support product demonstrations and functional walkthroughs when required.  Help maintain alignment between customer requirements, product strategy, and platform capabilities. F. Business Analyst Mentoring and Capability Development  Act as a functional mentor for junior and intermediate Business Analysts.  Guide BAs in insurance domain understanding, requirement analysis, functional documentation, and platform knowledge.  Conduct regular knowledge-sharing sessions on P&C insurance concepts and Solartis platform capabilities.  Review BA deliverables and provide structured feedback.  Establish templates, standards, checklists, and functional documentation guidelines.  Create reusable examples of insurance product definitions, business rules, rating specifications, and workflows.  Develop practical learning paths and competency assessments for junior BAs.  Gradually enable junior BAs to independently handle standard and moderately complex requirements.  Reduce dependency on existing senior BAs for routine requirement clarification and functional reviews. G. AI-Assisted Business Analysis and Knowledge Management  Collaborate with AI Engineering teams to identify opportunities to automate repetitive business analysis activities.  Provide insurance domain expertise for AI-assisted insurance document understanding and product digitization.  Define expected extraction structures for insurance products, coverages, rating factors, underwriting rules, and forms.  Validate AI-generated insurance product definitions and functional requirements.  Help establish canonical insurance data models, business terminology, and domain taxonomies.  Define business validation rules and exception scenarios for AI-generated outputs.  Contribute to AI-assisted requirements generation, test case generation, and functional validation workflows.  Help create an approved insurance domain knowledge repository containing validated business concepts, examples, and reusable functional patterns.  Ensure that AI-generated insurance interpretations are traceable to source documents and validated by authorized domain experts. 3. Insurance Domain Knowledge – Mandatory / Strongly Preferred Strong experience in US P&C insurance is highly preferred. The candidate should have substantial knowledge of: Insurance Product and Policy Lifecycle  Property & Casualty insurance products.  Policy administration and policy lifecycle management.  Quote, rating, underwriting, binding, issuance, endorsement, renewal, and cancellation.  Carrier, MGA, broker, and agent operating models. Insurance Product Configuration  Product definitions and product structures.  Coverages, limits, deductibles, exclusions, and endorsements.  Insurance forms and form applicability.  State-specific product variations.  Product eligibility and underwriting rules. Rating and Underwriting  Insurance rating methodologies.  Rating factors, rating tables, and calculation rules.  Premium calculation and rating dependencies.  Underwriting eligibility, referrals, restrictions, and exceptions.  Risk classification and rating-related data requirements. Insurance Documentation and Compliance  Insurance product manuals.  Rating manuals.  Underwriting guidelines.  Policy forms and endorsements.  State-specific supplements and regulatory requirements.  Statistical coding and insurance reporting requirements.  Familiarity with ACORD standards is an advantage. Experience with US insurance carriers, MGAs, policy administration platforms, rating engines, and insurance product configuration solutions will be particularly valuable. 4. Technical and Functional Knowledge  Strong understanding of enterprise insurance technology platforms.  Experience with product configuration and policy administration systems.  Understanding of business rules engines, rating engines, workflow engines, and integration concepts.  Ability to understand APIs, data structures, JSON, XML, and database concepts.  Experience working with Agile product development and software engineering teams.  Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, and requirement management tools.  Ability to interpret technical architecture and evaluate functional implications.  Awareness of AI/ML, GenAI, RAG, and document intelligence applications in insurance technology.  Experience working with structured metadata, data dictionaries, and canonical data models. 5. Experience and Qualifications Mandatory:  12–18 years of overall professional experience in insurance, InsurTech, or enterprise technology.  Significant experience in Business Analysis, Insurance Product Analysis, or Insurance Functional Consulting.  Strong hands-on experience in US P&C insurance business processes.  Proven experience independently handling complex insurance requirements.  Experience translating insurance business needs into detailed functional specifications.  Experience with insurance product configuration, rating, underwriting, and policy lifecycle processes.  Strong stakeholder communication and requirement management skills.  Demonstrated experience mentoring or reviewing the work of other BAs. Preferred:  Experience with insurance SaaS platforms and policy administration systems.  Experience with rating engines and insurance product configuration platforms.  Experience with US insurance carriers, MGAs, or insurance technology vendors.  Previous experience as an Insurance Product Specialist, Lead BA, Business Architect, or Insurance Functional Consultant.  Experience with Solartis or similar insurance technology platforms.  Experience supporting product modernization and digital transformation initiatives.  Exposure to AI-driven insurance product digitization and document intelligence.

The Analyst supports BAU processes, ensures accurate licence and discovery data, and provides the analytical insight required to maintain compliance, optimise software usage, and enable effective decision making across the SAM function. SAM Pro Platform Administration & Optimisation . Configure, administer, and optimise SAM Pro for enterprise software discovery, inventory, licence reconciliation, and reporting. . Create and maintain software asset information, including Software Models, Software Discovery Models, and Software Entitlements. . Resolve unmatched or partially normalised Software Discovery Models; manage normalisation against the SAM Content Library, including machine learning normalisation where enabled. . Operate and maintain Publisher Packs (for example Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP) to ensure accurate calculation of complex licence metrics (per user, per device, PVU, core). . Manage the software asset lifecycle within SAM Pro, from procurement and deployment through allocation, reclamation, retirement, and disposal. . Maintain CMDB and CSDM alignment, including CI relationships and data models that underpin reliable SAM data. . Develop custom reports and dashboards to track compliance, savings opportunities, and lifecycle management. . Confirm whether existing entitlements can be allocated before initiating procurement activity. . Identify cost avoidance opportunities (true ups, contract renewals) and cost saving initiatives (reharvesting, downgrades, reclamation). . title: Product Owner
description: Data Governance and Data Hygiene Product Owner One role · Contract-to-hire · India Role summary You will own the data hygiene program day to day. You will turn a backlog of more than 40 known data problems into defined, prioritized, and verified cleanup work. Over time, you will build that into a lasting data governance practice. You work directly with business leaders and operations teams, so clear communication and a real understanding of how the business runs matter as much as technical skill. What you will do Own and prioritize the data hygiene backlog, sequenced against the 2027 roadmap releases. Meet with business owners and operations leads to understand their processes, why the data breaks, and what clean data has to look like for them. Write clear business definitions and a business glossary for each data domain, in plain language business users can sign off on. Define critical fields, data quality rules, and how quality is measured for each domain. Plan bulk cleanups: what to fix, how (mass update, matching algorithm, or reload), how to validate it, and who signs off. Lead the two Data Quality Analysts: assign work, review their output, and remove blockers. Keep a gap log of each data issue found, who owns the fix, and when it closed. Work with the data platform and Salesforce teams on field and model changes, and with the data team on automated quality checks. Report progress to U.S. leadership in short, clear updates: what was cleaned, what changed in the numbers, and what is next. Over time, set up change control for new fields and definitions with business owners. What we are looking for Critical (must have) Communication. You explain data problems and trade-offs clearly to nontechnical business leaders, in writing and live. You run a meeting, push back politely, and follow up. Business understanding. You learn how an operations business works (how work moves from sale to field to invoice) and connect each data problem to its business impact. Technical skill. You write and read SQL well enough to profile data, check a cleanup, and challenge an analyst's work. Snowflake experience is preferred. Also required 5+ years in data governance, data quality, master data management, or a data product owner or business analyst role. Experience owning a backlog and prioritizing with business stakeholders. Experience writing data definitions, glossaries, or data quality rules. Comfortable working with U.S. teams until at least 12:00 p.m. Pacific. Nice to have Field service, facilities, utilities, telecom, or energy industry experience. Salesforce data model experience (Service Cloud or Field Service). Experience with data catalog or governance tools. Power BI or another BI tool. Agile and Azure DevOps. What success looks like in the first 90 days Glossaries and quality baselines in place for the asset and technician domains. The first bulk cleanups delivered and signed off by their business owners. A working weekly rhythm with business owners and the analysts, with a backlog leadership can see.

description: Senior Specialist, Change Management Role description summary The Senior Specialist, Change Management serves as a subject matter expert and governance authority responsible for driving the effective execution, compliance, and continual improvement of the ITIL Change Enablement practice across the combined SES and Intelsat environment. This role provides oversight of the end-to-end lifecycle of Change Requests (CRs) across all O&E segments, ensuring changes are assessed, authorized, implemented, and reviewed in accordance with established governance, risk, and operational standards. The Senior Specialist leads enterprise change governance activities, coordinates approvals through CAB, CCB, and Emergency Change processes, and partners with technical and business stakeholders to balance operational stability with business agility. Challenge and guide change owners to maintain high-quality submissions, appropriate risk assessments, robust implementation and backout plans, and effective post-implementation validation. Drive accountability for successful change execution and closure. Process Compliance & Governance Oversight: Monitor, measure, and report adherence to Change Management policies and controls across all O&E domains. Escalate significant risks and governance concerns to leadership when appropriate. Analyze change trends, incidents, and post-implementation reviews to identify recurring issues and opportunities for risk reduction. Partner with operational and engineering teams to strengthen risk-based decision-making and improve overall operational resilience.
